title: Acton teen accused of killing mom, brother ordered held without bail
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Arjun Aravind, 17, accused of killing mother Sudha Venkatesan, 45, and brother Siddharth, 14, was arraigned and held without bail.
Police discovered the bodies in their Acton home after a wellbeing check; both victims showed signs of blunt force trauma.
Aravind arrested in Wayland in his mother's car, charged with multiple counts, including murder and motor vehicle theft.

title: Downtown Boston was buzzing in July. Here’s a look at the numbers.
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Downtown Boston saw a 10.5% increase in domestic foot traffic in July 2026 compared to July 2025, driven by events like the World Cup.
Foot traffic on weekends downtown rebounded to 104% of 2019 levels, while weekday traffic reached 75% of pre-pandemic numbers.
Temple Place businesses reported a 40% sales increase during the temporary social district pilot from June 8 to July 31, 2026.

title: 2 seriously injured in stabbing near North Station, police say
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Two individuals sustained life-threatening injuries in a stabbing incident near North Station, Boston police reported.
The stabbing occurred on Lancaster Street shortly after 11 a.m., leading to police and emergency services' response.
The victims were transported to a nearby hospital; police have not released additional details on the incident.

title: Healey temporarily restricts kratom sales statewide
author: Ross Cristantiello
bullets: Governor Maura Healey designates kratom as a Schedule I substance statewide, citing high potential for abuse and safety risks.
Department of Public Health's temporary kratom restriction takes effect after 14 days and lasts up to one year.
Massachusetts joins 14 other states in restricting kratom, with the Boston City Council considering a local ban on synthetic products.

title: Two New England beach towns to visit before the summer ends
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Harwich, Cape Cod, recognized as the best town on the Cape, offers beaches, oyster specials, and sunset cruises.
Ogunquit in Maine is named the best beach town by Boston.com readers, offering various activities for visitors.
The Deerfield Fair, New England's oldest family fair since 1876, occurs October 1-4 in Deerfield, New Hampshire.

title: Diver dies in incident off Cape Cod
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: A 72-year-old diver died Wednesday off Cape Cod, about 2 nautical miles from Sesuit Harbor.
Dennis Fire Department led the search, aided by Barnstable, Sandwich departments, and U.S. Coast Guard aerial support.
The diver was located around 5:30 p.m., transported to Sesuit Harbor, and pronounced dead; investigation ongoing.

title: Livestream: Lindsay Clancy murder trial continues after graphic testimony about children’s autopsies
author: Abby Patkin
bullets: Lindsay Clancy's trial continues with testimony about graphic autopsy findings of her three children, focusing on asphyxia as the cause of death.
Massachusetts State Police Sgt. Kyle Pavao provided testimony on Lindsay Clancy's digital searches related to psychiatric care and suicide methods.
Defense claims Lindsay Clancy was suffering from postpartum mental illness and hearing voices, disputing her criminal responsibility for the killings.

title: Rhode Island beach house with water views on both sides — can you guess the price?
author: Emily Turner
bullets: A Westerly, Rhode Island beach house features water views on both sides and is built in a contemporary cottage style.
The beach house was built in 1987, has 2,724 square feet, 3 bedrooms, and 3 full bathrooms.
Annual taxes for the property are $11,125, and the listing price options are $1.98 million, $1.88 million, or $1.78 million.

title: 5 best new restaurant openings and dining updates in Boston (August 13, 2026)
author: Nathan Tavares
bullets: First Crush natural wine bar opening in Somerville's Union Square in mid-September 2026 at 259 Washington St.
Filipino-inspired Johnny Boy transforming from popup to permanent restaurant in Fort Point, opening fall 2026 at 300 Summer St.
The Temp Agency, a retro office-themed bar by Tiffani Faison, now open at High Street Place, Downtown Boston.

title: 3 concerning trends from Red Sox’ 5-game losing skid
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Red Sox have lost five consecutive games after previously losing only five times over 44 days.
Boston is struggling offensively, averaging 2.8 runs per game in the last five games compared to 5.6 earlier.
Defensive errors and bullpen struggles, including an injury to Garrett Whitlock, are contributing to the skid.
